rock_source.origin: Native ImageGen, isolated rock reference requested for this project
rock_source.prompt: Single monolithic dark-grey fractured bedrock buttress; broad angular planes, three-quarter neutral studio view, transparent background.

reconstruction.preprocess: unchanged alpha crop, 10 percent padding, white composite

finishing: Directional solid voxel fill, surface relaxation, Blender quadric LOD reduction, carved exterior placements, second closed-shell repair, corrected shading normals; existing project world-projected rock material
gallery: Project-authored procedural masonry from the existing dungeon source, rounded external mortar and new roof stones. Interior and collision preservation recorded in gallery-build.json.
limits: Raw reconstruction is not watertight. Only repaired, independently validated closed GLBs are integrated; raw GLB is ignored by Git.
Generated reference pixels are not used as a recovered texture atlas.
structure: Project-authored closed depth-field relief for four east-shaft wall edges, floor plinths, existing original procedural pier.obj, and original masonry.Wall supports. No new third-party geometry.
